text: 杭州海关所属义乌海关17日公布最新数据：截至10月17日，今年义乌海关监管的义乌跨境电商进口清单量突破1亿单，较去年达成该目标提前40余天，创同期历史新高。据悉，今年以来，义乌跨境电商进口商品涵盖食品、化妆品、婴幼儿奶粉、玩具等7万多个品类，来自全球90多个国家和地区。目前，义乌综合保税区和义乌保税物流中心集聚130多家跨境电商企业，今年前三季度跨境电商进口清单量达9605万单、货值237.79亿元人民币，分别同比增长25.1%和28.18%。（中国新闻网）
text_en: Yiwu Customs, under Hangzhou Customs, released the latest data on the 17th: as of October 17, the number of Yiwu cross-border e-commerce import lists supervised by Yiwu Customs this year exceeded 100 million, reaching the target more than 40 days earlier than last year and hitting a record high for the same period. It is reported that since the beginning of this year, Yiwu's cross-border e-commerce imported goods have covered more than 70,000 categories, including food, cosmetics, infant formula and toys, from more than 90 countries and regions around the world. Currently, the Yiwu Comprehensive Bonded Zone and the Yiwu Bonded Logistics Center have gathered more than 130 cross-border e-commerce companies. In the first three quarters of this year, the number of cross-border e-commerce import lists reached 96.05 million, with a value of 23.779 billion yuan, up 25.1% and 28.18% year on year, respectively. (China News Service)
